completions.definition:
`task_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`task_id`) REFERENCES `tasks`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action

plans.definition:
`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`start` text NOT NULL,
	`end` text NOT NULL,
	`priority` text NOT NULL,
	`criterion` text NOT NULL,
	`estimate` integer NOT NULL,
	`improvement` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL

reviews.definition:
`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`plan_id` text NOT NULL,
	`start` text NOT NULL,
	`end` text NOT NULL,
	`improvement` text NOT NULL,
	`next_plan_id` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`plan_id`) REFERENCES `plans`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`next_plan_id`) REFERENCES `plans`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action

revisions.definition:
`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`plan_id` text NOT NULL,
	`snapshot` text NOT NULL,
	`at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`plan_id`) REFERENCES `plans`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action

runs.definition:
`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`task_id` text NOT NULL,
	`start` text NOT NULL,
	`end` text NOT NULL,
	`minutes` integer NOT NULL,
	`reason` text NOT NULL,
	`note` text NOT NULL,
	`request_key` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`task_id`) REFERENCES `tasks`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action

tasks.definition:
`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`plan_id` text NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`due` text NOT NULL,
	`priority` text NOT NULL,
	`tags` text NOT NULL,
	`estimate` integer NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
	`deleted` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`created` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`plan_id`) REFERENCES `plans`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action

relations: completions.task_id → tasks.id (primary key: one current completion)

rules.timestamps: UTC ISO 8601; inputs and display Asia/Seoul
rules.scope: selected plan, non-deleted tasks with due date inside inclusive review period
rules.delayed_count: target tasks not done and due < Seoul today
rules.blocked_count: distinct target tasks with any nonblank run.reason
rules.actual: sum of all runs linked to target tasks
rules.history: atomic batch snapshots before update; stable plan ID
rules.idempotency: completions task_id primary key; runs request_key unique
rules.delete: soft delete; export retains all records
rules.export: all six tables as one JSON file
rules.execution_edit: update same run ID; recalculated duration; delete removes run and its aggregation
rules.execution_validation: positive duration <= 24h, no future end, note required
